case_number: Civil Appeal No. [Not Specified] of 2023 (Arising from S.L.P.(Civil) No. 13885/2022)

parties.respondent: Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Ltd. & Others

summary: Temporary land acquisition exceeding 25 years; violation of Article 300A; unreasonable rent (Rs. 30/sq.mt/annum vs. market rate Rs. 1000/sq.mt/month); undertaking for permanent acquisition unfulfilled; ONGC's acquisition on hold under LARR Act 2013; High Court directive to pay enhanced rent upheld; appeal dismissed affirming temporary possession with revised compensation framework.
legal_provisions_cited: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court judgment upheld; respondents directed to consider revised rent based on prevailing rates for temporary acquisition period.
